messages:
Maya Chen: Quick heads-up — Cohort 6 onboarding next week (Mon 3/30). Portal shows 18 seats allocated but signup sheet has 24 accepted. Can someone confirm final seat list? This affects our enablement session capacity.

Jon Patel: Oof, thanks. I saw the CSV — looks like duplicate entries from two contact points. @Priya can you confirm canonical list? I can reconcile duplicates if you point me to source.

Priya Rao: On it. canonical is the Airtable 'Cohort 6 — Enrollments' view. Link: https://airtable.com/appXYZ/cohort6. I pulled export at 1736540000 and it had 24 rows. Will check for duplicates.

CS-Bot: New form submissions: 6 submissions received in last 24h. Latest entries: 4 from harper@finco.com, 2 from james@acme.com. (automated)

Eli Vargas: If it's 24 seats we need two more enablement facilitators for breakout rooms. I can cover Mon AM slot but need another for PM. @Jon any chance you can split?

Jon Patel: I can take PM. Also: recommend sending prework deck + short RTQ survey today to cut time. Draft here: https://gdrive/repo/c6-prework. TL;DR: install SDK, run quick smoke test.

Maya Chen: Good call. Also flag: Acme (6 seats) flagged as 'at risk' in Gainsight — low product usage. Renewal touch should happen before onboarding ends. Can @Priya + @Eli do a joint 1:1 with their admin during week 2?

Priya Rao: Yes. I'll own the Acme renewal prep. Eli can you send tailored demo showing cost projections + perf gains? Put it in calendar for Apr 9.

Eli Vargas: Yup — will prepare perf slides + 15m ROI snippet. Sharing draft by Thu EOD. Action: @Jon update prework to include a perf benchmark link.

Jon Patel: Done — added short benchmark steps + sample output. Snippet: ```
python -m redwood smoke --model=rw-1 --seq=512
```

Maya Chen: Logistics: room capacity = 20. If final seats >20 we'll run hybrid (stream + breakout). @CS-Bot can you add a note to enrollment sheet to mark 'hybrid' for >20?

CS-Bot: Note added to 'Cohort 6 — Enrollments' view: field 'delivery_mode' set to 'hybrid' for rows where 'confirmed' > 20.

Priya Rao: Re duplicates: 3 duplicate rows removed, final confirmed = 21. Export saved: https://airtable.com/export/c6-1736554000.csv

Maya Chen: Great — final tally 21. Next actions: (1) Send prework + RTQ today (owner: Jon) (2) Assign second facilitator (owner: Eli) (3) Account check-in (owner: Priya) (4) Update enablement deck for Acme ROI (owner: Eli). I'll ping sales to confirm seat approvals.

Jon Patel: Sent prework + survey at 12:05pm. Slack note to cohort channel: :email:

Priya Rao: I pinged AE @Sam in sales — Sam confirmed seats and will send contract addendum. AE note: Sam said 'We expect sign-off by Apr 6'.

Maya Chen: Closing loop — office hours scheduled Wed 4/1 16:00 PT. Calendar invites sent to confirmed list. Thanks team :tada:
